lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Liberia in 2016. The spatial data represents classified food insecurity phases (IPC scenarios) aggregated by administrative or geographic units, reflecting population-level food security status as a post-event or ongoing crisis impact metric.
